task.title: Page complete one-shot schedule lifecycle histories
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1007 with bounded exact-ID discovery of complete validated one-shot schedule histories.
acceptance_criteria: Select at most one positive at-most-1024 schedule window plus lookahead and return complete revision-ordered histories in exact-ID order.
Advance an exclusive continuation cursor without requiring the cursor schedule to exist.
Fail closed on selected or lookahead corruption while isolating evidence outside the bounded window.

outcome.summary: Issue 1007 delivered bounded schedule-history discovery without event-level paging or lifecycle authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 1008 exact head ad98fea68024c5dd3f56f80f393a47b0963108c4

lessons: Inventory paging followed by exact history calls cannot guarantee that selection and lifecycle evidence came from one read snapshot.
The page bound limits selected streams and returned histories; complete replay and allocation within each selected schedule remain proportional to that schedule's lifecycle.
Lookahead must be canonically replayed before proving continuation, while corruption before the cursor, beyond lookahead, and in unrelated stream families remains isolated.
The boundary is read-only and adds no event-level cursor, clock, mutation, worker, dispatch, retry, permission, or execution authority.
